name: Macy Industries
old_description: In business since 1975, Macy is made up of a hardworking team of knowledgeable metal fabrication experts with quality and integrity in mind. From our family to yours, we appreciate your support and look forward to accommodating your metal fabrication needs.
about:
Macy Industries operates from Hooksett, New Hampshire, where it was founded in 1975 as a family-owned metal fabrication business. The company remains family-run, emphasizing a collaborative approach that spans design, fabrication, and installation.

The shop provides custom metal fabrication services including welding, cutting, machining, and forming of stainless steel, aluminum, galvanized steel, copper, and carbon fiber. Its modern facility produces dust, fume, and mist collection systems; HVAC ductwork; structural steel frames; machine frames; platforms; staircases; architectural panels; and a range of miscellaneous metal products. The team handles projects from engineering design through on-site installation and ongoing maintenance.

Customers span commercial, industrial, and residential sectors. Construction managers, general contractors, and architects specify Macy for metal staircases, railings, balconies, awnings, retractable roofs, and hydraulic doors used in hotels, restaurants, and retail spaces. Facility managers and industrial engineers rely on the company's dust and fume collection systems for production facilities, while residential architects incorporate copper hoods, countertops, and specialty railings into custom homes. The firm also serves architectural millwork shops, plumbing and HVAC contractors, and medical laboratory and commercial kitchen projects.

Macy differentiates itself through a proven collaborative process that integrates design, production, and installation, which the company says keeps clients returning with new projects. It highlights engineering creativity and flexibility to deliver products that are difficult for others to replicate, backed by in-house maintenance on everything it manufactures.
